frequency_question: What proportion of these intervention programs successfully scale up their operational volume to meet or exceed their initial target capacity within the specified time window?
membership_rule: Includes national treasury or central bank systematic purchase/buyback programs with stated phased volumetric targets; excludes ad-hoc emergency interventions without structured volumetric schedules.
window: Within a 2-to-3-year operational window from program inception.

cases.name: Federal Reserve Large-Scale Asset Purchases (QE3 expansion)
Bank of England Gilt Purchase Program (Truss aftermath intervention)
Reserve Bank of Australia Bond Purchase Program
Bank of Japan Rinban Buyback Operations Expansion
European Central Bank PEPP Volume Adjustments

coverage_note: 6 named; representative of major G10 systematic intervention scaling attempts over the past 15 years.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller emerging market interventions due to structural differences in debt depth.
validity_reason: Central bank and treasury intervention mechanics and scaling adherence patterns remain stable across standard monetary policy regimes.
